name: Praying In Public
overview: Scripture teaches that praying in public must be done with sincerity and humility rather than for outward approval. Jesus warns against praying to be seen by others, as the hypocrites do, who seek human praise and thus forfeit the reward from the Father in heaven. Instead, believers are encouraged to pray privately and sincerely, trusting that God, who sees in secret, will reward them openly. Additionally, prayer should avoid empty repetitions, focusing on genuine communication with God rather than vain displays.
